draftReview.title: Draft review
draftReview.description: Suggestions only. Nothing changes until you apply a suggestion, and nothing is saved or published until you save the draft yourself.
draftReview.emptyDraft: Fill in at least one reviewed field first: {{fields}}.

states.disabled: Draft review is turned off for this site.
states.unconfigured: Draft review is not set up for this collection yet.
states.stale: The draft changed after this review. Run it again before applying suggestions.
states.staleAfterApply: Applying a suggestion changed a reviewed field, so the other suggestions are out of date. Run the review again to use them.
states.abstained: Not enough information for a confident suggestion. You can record feedback or choose a value yourself.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to run draft reviews.
errors.quota: The site's review budget is used up. Nothing was checked.
errors.quotaRetry: The site's review budget is used up. Nothing was checked. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
errors.timeout: The review timed out. Nothing was checked.
errors.unavailable: The review provider is unavailable right now. Nothing was checked.
errors.fieldNotAllowed: Some reviewed fields are outside this profile or your permissions. Nothing was checked.
errors.tooLarge: The draft is too large to review. Nothing was checked.
errors.notFound: The item or review profile no longer exists.
errors.failed: The review failed. Nothing was checked.
errors.feedback: Your feedback was not recorded, so nothing was changed. Try again.

answer.feedbackOnly: Feedback only — this suggestion does not change a field.
answer.pinned: Pinned: {{field}} is locked by a human edit.

verdict.applied: Applied to {{field}}. Save the draft to keep it.
verdict.earlier: Earlier feedback was already recorded ({{verdict}}), so nothing was changed.
